5948.name: Black Prawn

5951.name: Bloodblotch

5952.name: Ruddy Seema
desc: A poisonous freshwater fish that populates the Zoldeff River in Foret de Hennetiel.

5953.name: Dragonfly Trout

5954.name: Barnacle

5957.name: Shockfish

5961.name: Contortopus
desc: A miniscule cephalopod that roams the Senroh Sea, protecting its life by squeezing into the tiniest of cracks.

5962.name: Contortacle

5963.name: Senroh Sardine
desc: One of the myriad fish that swim in the Senroh Sea near Ulbuka.
